title: ResolutionEvidenceCompilerResponse
description: Response payload for the resolution_evidence_compiler offering (e3-b2). CACHE_ONLY (Invariant #30) — same built-but-empty shape as prediction_market_research; no evidence-compilation pipeline exists yet for this phase, so this always returns NOT_YET_ANALYSED.

compiledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when evidence was last compiled, or null if never compiled.
